text: dsh-settings-about 为 DSH Web 设置侧栏增加“关于”页面。宿主端提供只读接口，从当前 DSH 进程收集运行版本、Node 与平台、配置档案、监听地址和可用链接；页面还列出已安装插件的模块、版本、启用状态及加载阶段。用户可隐藏内置插件、复制诊断摘要，或在请求失败时重试。适合查看 DSH 运行环境和核对插件清单。README 指定使用 @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.1 的 web profile，无需 API 密钥。

dsh-settings-about adds an About page to DSH Web settings. It shows runtime and platform details, profile, listen address, and installed plugin versions and states. Users can hide built-ins, copy diagnostics, and retry errors. It requires DSH 0.1.1-rc.1 with the web profile; no API key is needed.
想在 DSH Web 的设置里查看当前运行版本、Node 环境和配置档案。
有没有办法在设置页面核对已安装插件的版本和加载状态？
让 DSH 增加一个关于页面，并列出运行实例的基本信息。
插件启动失败时，我想复制一份运行诊断摘要方便查看。
How can I see the runtime version and profile details inside DSH Web settings?
I need a settings page that shows installed plugin versions and loader states.
Can I copy a concise diagnostics summary from the DSH About screen?
Add an About section that reports the running DSH environment and plugin inventory.
dsh-settings-about 的功能「运行环境摘要」：在设置的 About 页查看正在运行的 DSH 版本、Node 与平台、配置档案和监听地址；内容由宿主端按当前进程信息构建。
dsh-settings-about 的功能「已安装插件清单」：读取 Loader 条目并显示模块、可解析版本、启用状态和加载阶段；可切换隐藏内置插件。
dsh-settings-about 的功能「复制诊断摘要」：点击页面按钮将当前快照的诊断文本复制到剪贴板，并显示复制成功或失败状态。
dsh-settings-about 的功能「异常重试」：页面请求信息失败时显示错误消息和重试按钮，用户可再次请求宿主接口。
dsh-settings-about 的 README 指定使用 DSH 0.1.1-rc.1 的 web profile；其他版本兼容性未在已读实现中得到确认。

dsh-settings-about README · dsh-settings-about：[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) plugin that adds **Settings → About**: verified runtime facts from the *currently running* `dsh` process, plus an installed-plugin inventory (id, module, version, enabled, fiber phase).

dsh-settings-about README · Version requirements (important)：| Requirement | Constraint |
| --- | --- |
| **dsh** | **`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.1` only** (the `0.1.1-rc.*` line with credentials document **version 1**) |
| **Not supported** | `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.*` and older (flat `.credentials.yaml` without `version` / `refs`) |
| **Profile** | **`web` only** (this package ships a browser `dsh.client` UI) |
| **Node.js** | Whatever **that** dsh release requires (typically Node `^22.19 \|\| >=24`; verify with your install) |
| **pnpm** | Required on `PATH` — `dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm |

dsh-settings-about README · Version requirements (important)：Install / upgrade dsh first:

```sh
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.1
dsh --version   # must print 0.1.1-rc.1
```

Credentials must use the v1 layout (`version: 1` + `refs:`). If you still have a pre-release flat file, start `dsh web` once on `0.1.1-rc.1` and let it migrate, or convert manually — **do not** use a `0.1.0` parser against a v1 file (or the reverse).

dsh-settings-about README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:sha2kyou/dsh-settings-about
dsh web
```

Local checkout:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/sha2kyou/dsh-settings-about.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-settings-about
```

Then open **Settings → About**.

Update (GitHub install):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-settings-about

dsh-settings-about README · dsh plugin --profile web add github:sha2kyou/dsh-settings-about：```

Local checkout: `git pull` in the clone, then restart `dsh web` (a `link:`/`path` install already points at that directory).

Uninstall:sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-settings-about
```

dsh-settings-about README · Optional: About nav icon：Settings sidebar icons are hard-coded in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-general` by section id (unknown ids use the gear). To map `about` → `IconWarningOutline16`:

```sh
node scripts/patch-about-nav-icon.mjs

dsh-settings-about README · restart dsh web：```

Re-run after upgrading the global `dsh` install.
dsh-settings-about README · What the page shows：Values are collected from the running process only — missing data is omitted or listed under notes, never invented.

dsh-settings-about README · What the page shows：| Item | Source |
| --- | --- |
| dsh version / license / description / package name | `dirname(realpath(process.argv[1]))/../package.json` (same as `dsh` `lib/bin.js`) |
| Repository link | That `package.json` `repository.url` when convertible to http(s) |
| DSH_HOME | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths` from the same install |
| Node / platform | `process.version` / `platform` / `arch` |
| Profile / bundles | argv / profile path / `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/package.json` |
| Listen | Live `webServer.host:port` |
| Installed plugins | Cordis Loader entries (+ `package.json` version when resolvable). `builtin` is derived from profile `dependencies` only (no Loader provenance). UI can hide `builtin: true`. |

dsh-settings-about README · Layout：| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host plugin — `GET /dsh-about/info` |
| `collect.js` | Snapshot builder |
| `client.js` | Browser ModuleLoader bundle — `settings.section` `about` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle insert |
| `scripts/patch-about-nav-icon.mjs` | Optional shell icon patch |
